description: Register or update a device's push notification configuration for a user.

user_id.description: ID of the user registering the device

device_token.description: Platform push notification token (FCM, APNs, or web push)

platform.description: Device platform: ios, android, or web

categories.description: Notification categories to subscribe to; minimum 1. Valid values: marketing, transactional, security, reminders.

notification_types.description: Optional configuration for which notification presentation types are permitted on the device

badge.description: Whether badge count updates are enabled

alert.description: Whether visible alert notifications are enabled

badge_count.description: Optional initial badge count to set on the app icon

sound_name.description: Optional name of the sound file to play for notifications; use 'default' for the system default sound

content_available.description: Optional flag for iOS background fetch; when true, a silent push is delivered to wake the app

expiry_seconds.description: Optional time-to-live in seconds for undelivered notifications; after this period the notification is discarded
